messages.text: Compare the Cedar shipment plans. Which plan is latest, how much did it move, and does that establish actual shipment?

result.answer: The 20 May revision is the latest supplied Cedar plan. It changes planned shipment from 10 June to 17 June 2026, a seven-day delay, and explicitly replaces the 1 May plan. Neither source confirms an actual dispatch; the revised plan expressly says actual shipment is unconfirmed. A dispatch record is needed to determine actual shipment.

findings.text: The 1 May plan set Cedar shipment for 10 June 2026.

evidence.quote: Project Cedar shipment planned for 10 June 2026. This plan was issued on 1 May 2026.

findings.text: The 20 May revision sets 17 June 2026, explicitly replaces the 1 May plan, and says actual shipment is unconfirmed.

evidence.quote: Project Cedar shipment planned for 17 June 2026. This revised plan was issued on 20 May 2026. It replaces the 1 May plan. The actual shipment has not been confirmed.

findings.text: The latest supplied plan moves shipment seven calendar days later, from 10 to 17 June. The plans do not establish actual shipment.
uncertainty: No actual dispatch record was supplied.
Actual shipment cannot be established from the supplied plans.
